title: AisleGuard: Robot Route Replanning
question: How can a simulated warehouse robot find a short route after an aisle closes?
algorithm: Manhattan-heuristic A* with a second plan after a map update

title: FleetCell: Capability-Aware Robot Assignment
question: Which robot should take each task when capabilities and travel costs conflict?
algorithm: Exact subset dynamic programming for minimum-cost one-to-one task assignment

title: GripSense: Motor Telemetry Change Detection
question: Can an inexpensive detector flag a sustained change without learning the fault as normal?
algorithm: EWMA residual detector with a calibration window and frozen baseline on flagged readings

title: EdgeBrake: Latched Robot Watchdog Simulation
question: When should a host-side simulator latch a stop after stale telemetry or an emergency-stop event?
algorithm: Deterministic state machine with freshness checks and explicit healthy reset

title: RouteRelay: Road Closure Routing
question: Which route remains available when a road segment closes?
algorithm: Dijkstra shortest paths on a directed graph with excluded edge identifiers

title: ChargeWise: Deadline-Aware EV Charging
question: How can a shared charging site deliver energy before departure while favoring lower-cost hours?
algorithm: Integral minimum-cost maximum flow with vehicle, hourly-rate, and site-capacity constraints

title: TransitPulse: Bus Headway Holding Simulation
question: Can bounded holding reduce departure bunching without hiding passenger delay?
algorithm: Bounded terminal holding policy with before/after headway error and total hold time

title: AccessPath: Constraint-Aware Walking Routes
question: Which synthetic walking route meets a stated width and slope constraint while avoiding stairs?
algorithm: Filtered directed-graph shortest path with explicit rejected-edge reasons

question: When should an idealized battery charge or discharge while retaining a stated reserve?
algorithm: Discrete-state dynamic programming with power limits, energy balance, and terminal reserve

title: WaterWatch: Pressure Anomaly Review
question: Which synthetic pressure readings deserve review when sensors can be missing or unusually noisy?
algorithm: Median absolute deviation detector with a measurement-resolution floor and explicit UNKNOWN states

title: HeatHaven: Cooling-Center Coverage Planning
question: Which small set of candidate cooling centers covers the most synthetic neighborhood demand?
algorithm: Exact budgeted maximum coverage with a greedy comparison and transparent uncovered demand

title: FoodBridge: Perishable Inventory Allocation
question: Can a food-rescue desk fulfill timed requests while keeping expired lots out of allocations?
algorithm: Transactional SQLite first-expiring-first-out allocation using parameterized queries

title: CareSlot: Clinic Resource Scheduling
question: Can an appointment desk book more requests when available resources differ by slot?
algorithm: Exact subset dynamic programming maximizing bookings before minimizing total wait

title: ColdGuard: Cold-Chain Evidence Review
question: How much logged time is outside an illustrative storage band, and where is the evidence incomplete?

title: MedTrace: Synthetic FHIR Bundle Preflight
question: Can a small preflight catch duplicate identities and unresolved references before a synthetic bundle enters a pipeline?

title: RescueMesh: Offline Message Queue Simulation

question: Can a support assistant retrieve a relevant passage and refuse a query with insufficient evidence?

title: MaintenanceML: Synthetic Failure Classifier and Drift Review
question: Can a small classifier show its holdout results and reveal a shifted operating population?

title: ReleaseProof: Artifact and Test Evidence Gate
question: Should an illustrative release proceed when artifact digests and test records disagree?

title: OrbitWindow: Synthetic Ground-Station Scheduling
